plan.title: feat(changelog): path test, fragment format, mode and effective view (#6286 slice A)

narratives.Description: Slice A of the accepted #6286 CHANGELOG fragments design: one shared changelog path test, the fragment format, the `plan.policy.changelog.mode` policy and one effective view of unreleased entries. While the mode is `inline` (the default) and no fragment exists, no check changes its result.
narratives.Overview:
## Summary

Slice A of the accepted #6286 design (CHANGELOG fragments): one shared path test, the fragment format, the mode policy and one effective view of unreleased entries. It changes no outcome while the mode is `inline` (the default) and no fragment exists.

Bound contract: successor lean 6859392664 on #6286, items 1, 2, 3 and 5 (completed-arc record 6859436534). Slice B (gate, release, story scope) is a separate child issue. Each slice has its own issue so that each brief completes from exactly one PR with its own `deft-story` line until #6310 ships.

## Scope

1. A new exported `isChangelogEntryPath`: true for exactly `CHANGELOG.md` and for `changelog.d/<name>.md`, one segment deep, where `<name>` is lowercase letters, digits, `.`, `_` or `-`. Every check that matches the literal `CHANGELOG.md` as a path calls it instead: `scope/delivery-evidence.ts` (`isDeliveryBriefLandPath`), `scope-provenance/base-fence.ts`, `class-checks/evaluate.ts`, `verify-ac/evaluate.ts`, `policy/small-change-lane.ts`, `pr-closing-keywords/main.ts`, `presentation-ceiling/evaluate.ts`, `hooks/dispatcher.ts` (the retirement-shaped harvest), `check/session-completed-ac.ts`, `preflight-gh/pre-push.ts`, `coverage-applicability/evaluate.ts`, and `.github/scripts/artifact-only-lifecycle.mjs`.
2. Fragment format: a regular file whose first line is `section:` followed by one Keep a Changelog subsection name, then one or more entries that each start with `- ` (continuation lines indented). A line that starts with `#`, an empty file, an unknown section, a symlink or a non-regular file is invalid. File name: `<issue>-<slug>.md`.
3. Mode: `plan.policy.changelog.mode` is `inline` (default), `either` or `fragments`, with `policy:show --field` and a `--confirm` setter.
4. `readEffectiveUnreleased` returns the `[Unreleased]` entries of `CHANGELOG.md` plus the entries of all valid fragments, by subsection. Every reader of the unreleased section reads through it: `change:changelog:check`, the consumer-readiness census and new-refusal hints, `parseClosesSet`, and the coverage-debt, auto-hatch and skip-ci citation scans. Skill text that tells an agent to read `[Unreleased]` names the fragments too.

## Acceptance Criteria

- Given a literal `CHANGELOG.md` path match outside `isChangelogEntryPath`, when the contract test runs, then it fails and names the file.
- Given `changelog.d/6286-fragments.md`, then `isChangelogEntryPath` is true; given `changelog.d/sub/x.md`, `changelog.d/X.md` or `docs/CHANGELOG.md`, then it is false.
- Given a fragment with a valid `section:` line and `- ` entries, then it parses; given an empty file, an unknown section, a `#` line, a symlink or a non-regular file, then it is invalid.
- Given no policy value, then `policy:show --field=plan.policy.changelog.mode` reports `inline`; the setter accepts only `inline`, `either` and `fragments`, with `--confirm`.
- Given `[Unreleased]` entries and two valid fragments, then `readEffectiveUnreleased` returns all entries in their subsections, and each listed reader sees them.
- Given mode `inline` and no fragment, then every changed check returns the same result as before this change.

Refs #6286.

design-critique: not warranted, because this slice implements items 1, 2, 3 and 5 of the design already accepted on #6286 (lean 6859392664, record 6859436534) and adds no mechanism.
narratives.UserStory: As a maintainer moving to CHANGELOG fragments, I want one path test, one fragment format, a mode policy and one effective unreleased view, so that later gate and release work reads changelog entries the same way everywhere.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
1. Add `isChangelogEntryPath` in packages/core/src/changelog/entry-path.ts and route every literal `CHANGELOG.md` path match (delivery-evidence, base-fence, class-checks, verify-ac, small-change-lane, pr-closing-keywords, presentation-ceiling, hooks dispatcher, session-completed-ac, pre-push, coverage-applicability, artifact-only-lifecycle.mjs) through it, with a contract test that fails on a new literal match.
2. Add the fragment parser in packages/core/src/changelog/fragment.ts: a `section:` first line and `- ` entries; reject an empty file, an unknown section, a `#` line, a symlink or a non-regular file.
3. Add `plan.policy.changelog.mode` (`inline` default, `either`, `fragments`) in packages/core/src/policy/changelog-mode.ts, with `policy:show --field` and a `--confirm` setter wired in runtime policy.ts, dispatch.ts and route-argv.ts.
4. Add `readEffectiveUnreleased` in packages/core/src/changelog/effective-unreleased.ts and move the listed readers (change:changelog:check, consumer-readiness census, parseClosesSet, coverage-debt, auto-hatch, skip-ci) onto it; skill text that says to read `[Unreleased]` names the fragments too.
5. Add unit tests for each new module and keep the existing tests green to show inline-mode parity.
